category.description: Configuration category reported by the Ultimate firmware (e.g. 'Audio').

item.description: Specific configuration item inside the selected category (e.g. 'Volume'). Limits depend on op.

includeSecretValues.description: Return credential values (network password, FTP/Telnet passwords, Wi-Fi keys) in plain text. Default false: those values are replaced with ***.

value.description: Primitive configuration value (string, number, or boolean). Limits depend on op.

updates.description: Categories mapped to item/value pairs (primitive values only), for example {"Audio": {"Volume": 80}}.

additionalProperties.description: Item/value pairs of one category (primitive values only).

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path where the snapshot file will be written.

applyToFlash.description: When true, save the restored configuration to flash immediately (C64U/U64 and U2 only).

root.description: Root path to search for programs

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program in milliseconds

maxPrograms.description: Maximum number of programs to run

outputPath.description: Output directory for run logs and captures

resetDelayMs.description: Delay after reset operations to allow the platform to settle.

description:
Configuration operations available via the c64_config tool.

Operations:
- list: List configuration categories reported by the firmware. Required inputs: none.
- get: Read a configuration category or specific item. Required inputs: category. Optional inputs: item, includeSecretValues.
- set: Write a configuration value in the selected category. Required inputs: category, item, value.
- batch_update: Apply multiple configuration updates in a single request. Pass `updates` as {category: {item: value}}; categories as top-level keys are still accepted at runtime. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: updates.
- load_flash [c64u, u2]: Load configuration from flash storage. Required inputs: none.
- save_flash [c64u, u2]: Persist the current configuration to flash storage. Required inputs: none.
- reset_defaults [c64u, u2]: Reset firmware configuration to factory defaults. Required inputs: none.
- read_debugreg [c64u]: Read the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required inputs: none.
- write_debugreg [c64u]: Write a hex value to the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required inputs: value.
- info: Retrieve Ultimate hardware information and status. Required inputs: none.
- version: Fetch firmware version details. Required inputs: none.
- snapshot: Snapshot configuration to disk for later restore or diff. Required inputs: path.
- restore: Restore configuration from a snapshot file. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: applyToFlash.
- diff: Compare the current configuration with a snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- shuffle [c64u, u2]: Discover PRG/CRT files and run each with optional screen capture. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: root, extensions, durationMs, captureScreen, maxPrograms, outputPath, resetDelayMs.
